recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Changing the current short to the exact Jira phrase 'Notice receiver' would be editorial churn rather than a needed semantic correction.
issue_request: FHIR-17989 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Financial Management change request for STU3 PaymentNotice. It requested changing PaymentNotice.target to PaymentNotice.recipient and changing the short description to identify the notice receiver.
initial_application: The Jira-era GF#17989 batch commit f369c813fb40cd39c0db46336b2b3186f496fb47 changed the PaymentNotice example from target to recipient and changed the spreadsheet element from PaymentNotice.target to PaymentNotice.recipient with short 'Party being notified' and definition 'The party who is notified of the payment status.' The 2021 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried that recipient element and wording into the current StructureDefinition.
additional_context: PaymentNotice is active in source/fhir.ini. The only remaining PaymentNotice.target occurrence is a version-difference mapping to PaymentNotice.recipient, not a live element definition. The overlapping FHIR-19495 target-to-recipient cleanup has already been audited on the combined branch in commit d22c1340f45662a1cf14c2d447a99e772b256059. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current source/paymentnotice/structuredefinition-PaymentNotice.xml defines PaymentNotice.recipient with short 'Party being notified' and a definition explicitly saying it is the party notified of payment status, while the example also uses recipient.

related_jiras.note: Also requested PaymentNotice.target be renamed to recipient and is already represented on the combined branch by no-change audit commit d22c1340f45662a1cf14c2d447a99e772b256059.
